6. Fixation of pay on promotion from the Date of Next Increment (DNl).-Option is available under provisions of FR 22 (I) (a) (1) for fixation of pay from DNI. From the date of promotion till his DNI, he/she shall be placed in the next higher cell in the Level to which he/she is promoted. Subsequently on DNI, his/her pay will be re-fixed and two increments may be granted in the Level from which promoted and shall be placed at a cell equal to, if available or at the next higher cell in that Level of the post
